name: dos-platform
description: DOS Platform monorepo (platform DNA + services + modules + products).

scripts.clean: find . -name node_modules -type d -prune -exec rm -rf {} + ; find . -name dist -type d -prune -exec rm -rf {} +
scripts.foundation:gate: pnpm --filter @dos/module-foundation build && pnpm --filter shahin-ai-grc-frontend build && bash scripts/ci-guards/foundation-gate.sh
scripts.dynamic-ui:gates: node scripts/ci-guards/carbon-dynamic-ui-coherence.mjs && node scripts/ci-guards/dynamic-ui-loader-resolvability.mjs && COMPONENT_MAP_ENFORCE=1 node scripts/ci-guards/component-map-coverage.mjs && TEMPLATE_COVERAGE_ENFORCE=1 node scripts/ci-guards/template-coverage.mjs && UI_REGISTRY_ENFORCE=1 node scripts/ui-registry/verify.mjs && AUTH_PAGES_COVERAGE_ENFORCE=1 node scripts/ci-guards/auth-pages-coverage.mjs
scripts.platform:release-gate: pnpm dynamic-ui:gates && pnpm --filter shahin-ai-grc-frontend build && pnpm --filter @dos/module-foundation build
scripts.platform:customer-gate: pnpm dynamic-ui:gates && pnpm --filter shahin-ai-grc-frontend build && node scripts/ci-guards/props-coverage.mjs && WORKSPACE_SHELL_COVERAGE_ENFORCE=1 node scripts/ci-guards/workspace-shell-coverage.mjs && TEMPLATE_ONLY_ROUTING_ENFORCE=1 node scripts/ci-guards/template-only-routing.mjs
scripts.module:gates: SEED_PACK_PARITY_ENFORCE=1 node scripts/ci-guards/seed-pack-md-json-parity.mjs && MODULE_TEMPLATE_APPROVAL_ENFORCE=1 node scripts/ci-guards/module-template-approval.mjs && MODULE_CONTRACT_PUBLISHER_ONLY_ENFORCE=1 node scripts/ci-guards/module-contract-publisher-only.mjs && node scripts/module/reconcile.mjs workspace-shell --full --dry-run --skip-parity --skip-db-gap-verify --skip-frontend --skip-api-probe
